title: Experiment
description: The generic information about an experiment such as labels and names.

id.description: The unique ID for this experiment

creation_date.description: The date this client was created.

start_date.description: The date this experiment will go live.

stop_date.description: The date this experiment will stop.

description.description: The general description for this experiment

media.description: The media associated with this experiment for display to a user.
media.title: ExperimentMedia

hero_image_url.description: The URL of the image used when displaying the hero of this experiment

status.description: The status of this given experiment

project_id.description: The project that owns this experiment which can then map to an organization or billable entity.

org_id.description: The organization that owns this particular experiment.

external_id.description: The external ID of this experiment if the experiment is being run outside of the platform.

external_source.description: If running externally what is the source of this experiment (Growthbook, Mode, etc)

scopes.description: The additional scopes that this experiment needs in order to run.

privacy_url.description: Additional privacy disclaimers with links for this experiment.

tos_url.description: Additional terms and conditions for this experiment.
